title: Outdated dependencies
description: Structured list of outdated third-party npm dependencies and their available versions, authored by the check_outdated_dependencies stage.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the list was collected.

outdated.description: One entry per outdated package; empty when everything is up to date.

current.description: Installed version, or '-' when the package is not installed.

wanted.description: Max version satisfying the declared semver range.

latest.description: Latest version published to the registry.

type.description: Dependency group, e.g. dependencies / devDependencies / peerDependencies.

location.description: Workspace path where the dependency is declared, when known.
